### Irony: Singing about Sleep and New Babies...in the same Psalm!
Author: Erik Raymond
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/erik-raymond/irony-singing-about-sleep-and-new-babies-in-the-same-psalm/
Passage: Psalm 127:2-3
Points:
- The psalm intentionally pairs the blessing of peaceful sleep with the blessing of children.
- Frantic, relentless labor reveals a faulty self-dependence that overlooks God's sovereign care.
- Accepting rest is an act of humble trust and worship rather than wasted time.
- Children should be welcomed as undeserved gifts and divine trusts rather than burdens.
- Believers demonstrate their faith practically through how they work, rest, and love their families.

### Unless the Lord Builds the House...
Author: Barry R. Leventhal
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/family/marriage/unless-the-lord-builds-the-house-11549669.html
Passage: Psalm 127:1-5
Points:
- Human strategies and programs cannot build a lasting family without total dependence on God.
- Daily prayer and worship recognize that the Lord alone protects and establishes the home.
- Refusing workaholism allows believers to escape anxious toil and enjoy God-given rest.
- God works on our behalf while we sleep, granting physical recovery and spiritual renewal.
- Children are entrusted by God as blessings to be raised as future kingdom disciples.
